I just wanted to make a helpful list for people specifically wanting to make games.

Now instead of compiling a list of every single game engine or framework available, I wanted to create a list of stuff worth mentioning without all the annoying stuff (being either bloated or outdated) or anything with a painful license (GPL, issues with the subscription).

I'm willing to take suggestions as to what could be added to this list or could be removed in order to be more helpful.

 

Game Engines (a.k.a. "I want to make a game")

Name Platform Exports to 3D/2D Language Price Notes
RPG Maker Windows Windows 2D Ruby $0 - $69.99  
GameMaker: Studio Windows Windows, Mac, Linux, Web, Android, iOS, Tizen, Windows Phone, Xbox One, PS3/4/Vita 2D GML $0 - $799.99 You have to pay extra to export to platforms other than Windows.
ImpactJS Web Web, Android, iOS 2D Javascript $99  
Stencyl Windows, Mac, Linux Windows, Mac, Linux, Web, Android, iOS 2D Haxe, Visual Scripting (similar to Scratch) $0 - $199/year You have to pay extra to export to platforms other than the Web.
Unity Windows, Mac Windows, Mac, Linux, Web, Android, Blackberry, iOS, Tizen, Windows Phone, Samsung TV, Xbox 360/One, PS3/4/Vita 3D and 2D C#, Javascript $0 - $75/month - $1,500 No royalties, but if you earned/received more than $100,000 in the last financial year, then you are required to purchase the Professional Edition.
Unreal Engine 4 Windows, Mac, Linux Windows, Mac, Linux, Web, Android, iOS, Xbox One, PS4 3D and 2D C++, Blueprints (visual scripting) $0 Free access to the source code. 5% royalty after first $3000USD per quarter.
Godot Windows, Mac, Linux Windows, Mac, Linux, Web, Android, Blackberry, iOS, Consoles? 3D and 2D GDScript (similar to Python) $0 MIT license. Documentation not fully complete yet.
Polycode Windows, Mac, Linux Windows, Mac, Linux 3D and 2D C++, Lua $0 MIT license. Currently in beta.
Torque3D Windows, Mac Windows, Mac 3D TorqueScript $0 MIT license.
jMonkeyEngine Windows, Mac, Linux Windows, Mac, Linux, Android 3D Java or any other JVM language $0 BSD license.

Note: If you didn't already know, to develop games for certain mobile/console platforms you are actually required to have a license.

 

Frameworks (a.k.a. "I want to program a game")

Name Written in Language support Notes
Love2D C++, Lua Lua Zlib license. Intended for the creation of 2D games.
NÃN Moonscript, Java Moonscript MIT License. Inspired by Love2D.
SFML C++ C++, C, C#, VB.net, Crystal, D, Euphoria, Go, Java, Julia, Nim, OCaml, Pascal, Python, Ruby, Rust Zlib license. Intended for the creation of games and other multimedia applications.
